spec_match.rationale: Probes the constructor change (length now optional, null attribute) and the shipped error contract (zero chunk, oversized chunk, exhausted context) with real calls, matching the implementation's exact exception types and the spec's constructor section.

interactive.rationale: Three buttons drive real constructions and renders: the no-length probe, the per-quantum chunk pump on a live indefinite context, and the four-probe error ladder.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the optional-length constructor, null length readout and the error ladder; all present.

edge_cases.rationale: This page IS the edge angle: every rung handles both the 158 outcome and the legacy outcome (argument ignored / TypeError / single-call InvalidStateError), each labelled as the honest answer for its build.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5109900936085504 and the spec's constructor section; crumbs reach the full feature reference list.

conformance.rationale: The suite's optional-length, zero-chunk and exhausted-context assertions encode the same rungs; the exhausted-context contract legitimately holds on both build generations and the suite's description says which message each produces.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): constructor probe threw the exact TypeError ('Required member is undefined') with the honest pre-158 explanation, chunk pump correctly stayed disabled, ladder filled all four rows (arguments ignored twice, InvalidStateError on the exhausted call, TypeError on no-length) with the legacy summary; zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow, desktop screenshot read. Partial: the indefinite-context path needs a 158+ build.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts cover both constructor branches (oac-indefinite-constructed / oac-indefinite-honest-typeerror) and the ladder row count; all rejections are caught and tabulated.

design_system.rationale: Ladder result colors (emerald/rose) sit on bg-paper at AA and are paired with full exception text, never color alone.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons (44px), definition-list readouts that collapse on narrow widths, caption + scoped-header table, outputs are aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the indefinite context on a Chrome 158+ build
openQuestions.detail: On a 158+ build, verify the no-length constructor yields length === null, repeated no-argument startRendering returns one render quantum per call, and the ladder's zero/oversized rungs reject NotSupportedError as the implementation specifies.

guidanceConsulted.query: error state table exception reporting accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair color-coded outcomes with the literal message text; keep interactive controls native and labelled.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every ladder cell prints the full exception name and message; controls are native buttons with visible labels and disabled states that reflect real capability.

guidanceConsulted.query: long running incremental operation state communication
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Communicate incremental state from real completion data.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The chunk counter readout reports real frames/currentTime after each pump press rather than an animated placeholder.

summary: The optional-length constructor, null length readout, per-quantum chunk pump and four-rung error ladder, all real calls. Driven on headless Chromium 141 (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): exact legacy TypeError and ignored-argument outcomes honestly labelled, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
